				desc = cwp_india.1.f_gbr
				trigger = { c:GBR ?= this }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_india.1.f_hnd
			}
		}
	}

	event_image = {

	}

	option = {
		name = cwp_india.1.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
}
